title: Haas CNC G-Code and M-Code Programming
source: CNCCookbook Haas Programming Guide + Autodesk Haas Post

tips.title: G12/G13 Haas circular pocket milling
tips.body: Haas-specific G12 (CW) and G13 (CCW) circular pocket milling cycles. Parameters: D=tool offset, I=first circle radius, K=finish radius, Q=stepover increment, L=loop count for depth. Position tool above center before calling. Faster than CAM-generated helical moves for simple circular pockets.

tips.title: G53 vs G28 for machine home moves
tips.body: Prefer G53 over G28 G91 Z0 for machine coordinate moves on Haas. G53 is cleaner because G90 stays active (G28 implicitly uses incremental). Syntax: G53 Y0 moves table to machine zero Y; G53 G49 Z0 moves to machine zero Z with TLO cancel. G53 is non-modal (one block only).

tips.title: G150 Haas general purpose pocket milling
tips.body: G150 is Haas's 'mini-CAM in G-code' for arbitrary pocket shapes. Define pocket outline in a SUBPROGRAM (not subroutine). Parameters: P=subprogram number, Q=Z stepdown, R=retract plane. Requires pre-drilled entry hole to full depth. Maximum 40 moves in pocket definition. No Z finish pass (walls only).

tips.title: Haas tapping with G95 feed-per-rev
tips.body: For reliable rigid tapping on Haas, use G95 feed-per-rev mode instead of calculating F=pitch×RPM. Set useG95forTapping option in post processor. G95 mode automatically synchronizes feed with spindle speed. For manual programming: G95 G84 Z-depth R-retract F[pitch].

tips.title: Haas SSV spindle speed variation for chatter
tips.body: M138 enables Spindle Speed Variation (SSV), M139 disables. SSV continuously varies spindle RPM within a range to break up chatter harmonics. Use on long cuts or when chatter develops. NGC feature. Combine with G187 smoothing control (P1=rough, P2=medium, P3=finish) for optimal surface finish.

tips.title: G154 P1-P99 extended work offsets on Haas
tips.body: Haas NGC provides 99 additional work coordinate systems via G154 P1 through G154 P99, beyond standard G54-G59. Useful for tombstone setups, pallet systems, or multi-part fixtures. Each G154 Pn is a complete 6-axis offset like G54.

tips.title: Cancel G68/G54.4 before Haas probing
tips.body: Critical: Cannot probe while G68 coordinate rotation or G54.4 workpiece setting error compensation is active on Haas. Always issue G69 (cancel rotation) and/or cancel G54.4 before probing cycles. Resume rotation/compensation after probing complete.
